title: Answer: mammals, with a neocortex, perhaps birds, and not reptiles

statements.text: Consciousness belongs to beings whose brains can interact with psychons: mammals, through the neocortex, and perhaps birds, through the Wulst. Reptiles, lacking a neocortex, are not conscious. What holds of human souls holds of any conscious being.

sources.quote: So conscious experiences would give mammals evolutionary advantage over the reptiles, which lack a neocortex giving consciousness.
What applies to me applies to all other humans and any other conscious beings there may be.
